owner: Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic government (state program, Nakhchivan City Communication Department)
notes: Tier-3 level state data center planned in Nakhchivan city, announced Oct 2023 (design works started, design targeted for 1 Mar 2024 per Nakhchivan City Communication Department). On 11 Jan 2024 local press reported construction of the Data Center and related technical infrastructure planned within 2024, that the tender had been completed, and that 2,000,000 AZN allocated by Presidential Order had been ordered from the Ministry of Finance, under the State Program for the socio-economic development of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic 2023-2027. A separate Dec 2022 report mentioned creation of a reserve data center in Nakhchivan. No MW capacity or operator/developer company disclosed.
